paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.61 as of October 30, representing a decrease of 8.74 percent from the prior close and 38 percent over a window of 23 sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Fermi Inc. has recently announced that it is advancing development at its Project Matador site while shifting its commercial strategy toward a powered-land model, as reported by Yahoo Finance on November 2. This news comes after the company's annual shareholder meeting where a director vote failed.

There have been recent filings, including four Form 4 filings and three Form 144 filings, with the most recent Form 4 filing occurring on October 22 and the most recent Form 144 filing occurring on October 20. Additionally, an 8-K filing was made on October 16, announcing an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd.
